title: FluEmbed predicts H3N2 antigenic drift from sequence alone
summary: FluEmbed, a protein language model framework, predicted influenza A (H3N2) antigenicity from RNA sequence with Spearman correlations of 0.67 to 0.80 against hemagglutination inhibition titers. It outperformed Hamming, BLOSUM62 and phylogenetic baselines, and in-silico mutagenesis showed unconstrained mutations carry greater escape potential outside dominant lineages. Validation uses existing HI assay data and retrospective sequences; no new wet-lab tests were run.
